privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: XAIS ("we", "us") is committed to protecting your personal data. This policy describes what data we collect, why we collect it, how we use it, and your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

dataController.title: Data Controller
dataController.content: XAIS SOLUCES, headquartered in Saint-Raphaël, Var, France. Contact: contact@xaisoluces.com. As data controller, XAIS determines the purposes and means of processing your personal data.

dataCollected.title: Data Collected
dataCollected.content: We collect the following data: account information (name, email address, hashed password); organization information (name, domain); documents you upload for analysis; usage metadata (actions performed, timestamps); billing data (managed by Stripe — we never access card details); technical logs (IP addresses, user-agent, for security and debugging purposes).

purpose.title: Purpose of Processing
purpose.content: Your data is processed for the following purposes: providing and improving the document intelligence service; AI analysis of your documents via Claude (Anthropic) and Gemini (Google); account management and authentication; billing and subscription management via Stripe; customer support; security and fraud prevention; aggregated and anonymized usage statistics.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis
legalBasis.content: Data processing is based on the following legal grounds: performance of a contract (Art. 6.1.b GDPR) for service delivery; legitimate interests (Art. 6.1.f GDPR) for security and service improvement; legal obligation (Art. 6.1.c GDPR) for retaining billing records; consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR) for non-essential cookies where applicable.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: Account data is retained for the duration of your subscription and 3 years after termination. Uploaded documents are retained as needed for analysis and may be deleted on request or upon account closure. Billing data is retained for 10 years as required by French law. Technical logs are retained for 12 months.

thirdParties.title: Sub-processors and Transfers
thirdParties.content: We use the following sub-processors: Supabase Inc. (database and authentication, EU servers); Vercel Inc. (frontend hosting, EU/US servers with Privacy Shield); Render Inc. (API/Worker compute, US servers); Stripe Inc. (payments, EU/US servers, PCI DSS certified); Anthropic PBC (Claude model for AI analysis, US servers); Google LLC (Gemini models for embeddings, US servers). Transfers outside the EU are governed by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or equivalent mechanisms.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: Under GDPR, you have the following rights: access to your personal data; rectification of inaccurate data; erasure ('right to be forgotten'); data portability; objection to processing; restriction of processing. To exercise these rights, contact us at contact@xaisoluces.com. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: XAIS Vault uses only strictly necessary cookies for service operation: Supabase session cookie (authentication) and language preferences. We do not use advertising tracking cookies or third-party marketing cookies. No consent is required for these functional cookies.

contact.title: Contact & DPO
contact.content: For any questions regarding your personal data, contact our Data Protection Officer: contact@xaisoluces.com. We are committed to responding within 30 days.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern access to and use of the XAIS Vault platform, a document intelligence service published by XAIS SOLUCES. By using the service, you agree to all of these terms.

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.content: 'Service' means the deployed XAIS Vault application. 'User' means any individual with an account. 'Organization' means the entity (company, firm, fund) grouping multiple users. 'Content' means any document, file or data uploaded by a user. 'Plan' means the subscribed pricing tier.

object.title: Service Description
object.content: XAIS Vault is a SaaS document intelligence platform for professionals handling document volume (researchers, lawyers, consultants, journalists, PE/VC/M&A analysts, product managers, students, etc.). The service enables automated document analysis, insights extraction, deliverable generation (summaries, analysis memos, reports), and team collaboration.

access.title: Access and Registration
access.content: Access to the service requires creating an account with a valid email address and password. Users are responsible for keeping their credentials confidential. Organizations can have multiple users with different roles: Administrator (organization and member management), Analyst (workspace creation and document uploads), Viewer (read-only access). Registration implies acceptance of these Terms.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions and Billing
subscriptions.content: The service is offered under several pricing plans (Starter, Premium, Team, Enterprise) detailed on the pricing page. Billing is monthly or annual, processed via Stripe. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled. A free trial may be offered with no commitment. Prices are in euros, excluding taxes. XAIS reserves the right to modify pricing with 30 days' notice.

obligations.title: User Obligations
obligations.content: Users agree to: use the service for its intended purpose (professional document analysis); not attempt to circumvent security measures or reverse-engineer the service; not upload unlawful documents, content infringing third-party rights, or malware; respect plan limits (number of workspaces, sources, analyses); maintain account confidentiality.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: XAIS retains all intellectual property rights in the service, its code, interfaces, and trademarks. Users retain all rights in the documents they upload. XAIS obtains a limited, non-exclusive, revocable license to process those documents solely for service delivery purposes. Generated deliverables belong to the user.

liability.title: Liability and AI Disclaimers
liability.content: XAIS Vault is a decision-support tool. AI-generated analyses and deliverables do not constitute legal, financial, or investment advice. Users assume full responsibility for decisions made on the basis of generated analyses. XAIS's liability is limited to amounts paid in the preceding 12 months. XAIS is not liable for service interruptions or data losses beyond agreed SLA commitments.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: Users may cancel their subscription at any time from account settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. XAIS may suspend or terminate an account for ToS violations, with prior notice except in urgent cases. Upon termination, data is retained for 30 days then deleted, unless legally required otherwise.

applicableLaw.title: Governing Law and Jurisdiction
applicableLaw.content: These Terms are governed by French law. In case of dispute, the parties agree to seek an amicable resolution first. Failing that, the competent court will be that of XAIS SOLUCES's registered office (Var, France), unless mandatory legal provisions apply.

editor.content: This public repository is a source-code snapshot and is not currently operated as a hosted service. Any deployment operator is responsible for publishing legal information applicable to their instance.

personalData.content: The processing of personal data collected through this site is described in our Privacy Policy, accessible at /privacy. In accordance with GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, and port your data. To exercise these rights: contact@xaisoluces.com.
